text_en: Is there really an entire Fire Temple behind that mysterious door in the Forest of Fyr?
That soldier... Melian? He's back, and badly injured, but it looks like all you suffered from was a dusting of soot. Your armour's covered.
Tell me everything! Just how terrifying was that creature he was talking about? How did you manage to beat it?
Alright, alright... I'll try to curb my enthusiasm...
